data.name: NexaSC
data.subtitle: SoundCloud Go+ unlock and ad removal (unofficial build)
data.localizedDescription: NexaSC is a community SoundCloud tweak by cielogic: it unlocks SoundCloud Go+ features, removes ads, adds track downloads and can fetch lyrics automatically (via LRCLIB). The tweak is opened by long-pressing the home icon.

compatibility.notes: UNOFFICIAL BUILD. NexaSC has no public repository or developer feed - the only distribution channel is the IPA Vault source, so no developer-published download link exists to verify. Not affiliated with or endorsed by SoundCloud Ltd. Current SoundCloud 8.x builds require iOS 16.4 or newer (a pinned 7.68.1 build for iOS 16.0-16.3 also exists in the vault but is not tracked here). Shares com.soundcloud.TouchApp with TTKillerPlus in this catalog - install one at a time.
